Cash and cash equivalents
For the purposes of the statement of cash flows, cash and cash equivalents includes cash on hand and in banks,
short term liquid investments which are readily convertible to known amounts of cash and which were within three
months of maturity when acquired, net of outstanding bank overdrafts and short term loans.
